fact: CAPMAS president Khairat Barakat said the national strategy for the development of statistics in Egypt would be launched soon, that its launch had been delayed by COVID-19 and the Ukraine war, and that a meeting of about 17 participating ministries was set for that day to review the work done.
title: الإحصاء: إطلاق الاستراتيجية الوطنية لتطوير الإحصاءات في مصر خلال الفترة المقبلة
